runs.one_thing: Make sure every post this week lands on a stage check that works: get main building again and swap the dead .co.uk address out of next week's batch before the Wednesday 21 October post.
runs.roundup:
124 pull requests merged and only this board is open, so nothing is sitting in a drawer. The child's home got simpler, DiGi now agrees the ending before the screen goes on, the shorts are ready for the family account, the LinkedIn queue restarted at GDC 018 and the Planet Post printables are built. We also found referrals had no tables because migration 360 was never applied, and fixed it.

What is stuck. Main has been red since this afternoon: the Guided Planet migration made seven tables with no grants and both Vercel builds fail, so nothing new ships until that is sorted. Next week's posts print guidedchildhood.co.uk, which is a dead page. And I cannot tell you how many stage checks we have had since 1 October, because the product only counts film and school links and the posted log is empty. Revenue is still £0 and nobody has run a live founder checkout on the new Stripe account.

The one thing: every post this week lands on a stage check that works.

What I need from you. Run one live founder checkout on a clean email. Put the stage checks and posts since 1 October from the tracker into the board. Confirm the ICO fee is paid and which Vercel project is the real one. Then some quick calls when a session asks: the parent's grace day, under fours, the journey page name, the homework hint, the Pathway Session line and the old CrewAI crew.

headlines.ai-tools-watch: DiGi's top model is still the newest Fable, but three new models landed in three weeks and the fallbacks and the cheap tier are now a generation behind, with no batching on the nightly jobs.
headlines.competitor-watch: A quiet four weeks: nobody has shipped our core loop, and the one real move (Qustodio reading a child's ChatGPT chats) is the spying route we have chosen not to take.
headlines.keeps-coming-back: Both sides have a daily task, a streak, a reward and a gentle evening nudge, but the parent's flame goes to zero after one missed day and the evening push never stops for a parent who has gone quiet.
headlines.marketing: The funnel and the hook are right and every piece points at the stage check, but next week's social posts print a web address that returns a 404, and nothing yet tells us which channel brings a single check.
headlines.right-audience: The customer is the right one and the pages mostly speak to her, but the youngest end of the range has no first step and some pages use our words rather than hers.
headlines.simplicity-flow: Home has a clear order and a real picker, but the parent app still has eighty pages, one Pathway page with four names, and a Home that can hold about forty kinds of card.
headlines.solves-problem: The switch off fight and the bedtime battle have a full loop from naming it to tonight's words to a visible change, but the first phone worry loses its words button at the check in and gets a bedtime step on Tonight.
headlines.ux-expert: The design system is strong and well guarded, but the phone craft has gaps: small tap targets, hardcoded colours in the thousands, and loading and focus states that only cover the front doors.
headlines.value-above-ai: Most of what a free chatbot cannot do is built and wired in, but the home page only names the memory, so a parent meets the child app, the measured worry and the tested words late.
headlines.will-pay: The ask is honest and the cap is real, but it names parts not what a chatbot cannot do, it lands before the parent has seen anything back, and nobody has paid yet.
headlines.business-running: Work moves fast and nothing sits in a drawer, but main has been red since this afternoon, the open work list in THE-STORY is out of date, and nobody can say how many stage checks the founding sprint has made.

top_gap.ai-tools-watch: Move the fallback ladders from claude-opus-5 and claude-sonnet-5 (now legacy) to claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5 in both config files, widen the fast mode regex to include claude-opus-5-5 (fast mode now exists on Opus 5.5), update the guard's expectations, and run the DiGi evals once before merging.
top_gap.competitor-watch: Correct THE-STORY.md section 6, which still says 'against Jigsaw at £795 entry' when the 9 September check found that figure untraceable and Jigsaw's own site says from £495, so every session briefing quotes a wrong competitor price.
top_gap.keeps-coming-back: Stop the nightly evening push after about 7 days of the parent not showing up, so it cannot run for ever, and leave only the 4 day re-engagement line. Add a lapse check to runEveningPass using the same 'done today' reading it already builds.
top_gap.marketing: Replace guidedchildhood.co.uk/starter-pack with the live guidedchildhood.com/starter-pack in the three decks and caption files for the week of 19 October and in THIS-WEEK.md, then add a check in npm run ai-tells or a small guard script that fails on any .co.uk link in content/ and tools/social-cards.
top_gap.right-audience: Give the parent of a 2 or 3 year old a real first step. Add an 'under 4' route in the stage check and the signup that says plainly what is here for her now (co viewing, the ending agreed before the screen goes on, no solo device). Today the code clamps under 4s into the 4 to 7 band, and every public surface says 4 to 16.
top_gap.simplicity-flow: Pick one name for the journey page and use it everywhere. Today the route is /dashboard/pathway, the tab says 'Passport', the Home tile says 'Road to sixteen', and DiGi's back link says "Today's pathway", which means the daily list. THE-STORY section 11 asked for this rename and the August reversal left it undone. Rename the visible labels first (tab, tile, back link, scripts back link), keep the route and redirect.
top_gap.solves-problem: Add the missing concern slugs to CONCERN_TO_CATEGORY: phones-and-messaging to family-rules, seen-something to staying-safe, controller-fights to gaming. At the moment categoryForConcern returns null for the first two and everyday-routines for the third. A parent who rates 'Phones and messaging' as really tough sees Ask DiGi and no Get the words button, because the pill renders null. 'Asking for a phone' is the second most common onboarding answer.
top_gap.ux-expert: Add one global rule that sets a 44px minimum height and width on small icon buttons, then fix the worst offenders: the 34px close circles and the 30px plus and minus star steppers. Add a tap target check to the guards, since none exists and larger-text-guard needs Playwright.
top_gap.value-above-ai: Add one short home page section in a parent's words that names the four things a chatbot cannot do. It remembers last Tuesday, your child has their own app, a worry is scored from day one and shown moving, and the words are tested scripts you can print. Do not name a model. Today the home page only says 'DiGi remembers' and shows 'the wellbeing tracker' as a chip.
top_gap.will-pay: Make the ask personal. On the choose screen and the upgrade page, say what the parent keeps in their own words, using real data: the child's name, the worry being tracked, the scripts they have saved, the star quest set up, the check ins so far (for example 'Teo's history, the bedtime worry you are tracking and the quest you set up all stay'). Today the copy is the same for every family and lists features. Also move or repeat the ask so it follows the first check in or first script, when the parent has seen something back, as THE-STORY section 9 describes. The code now asks at the end of sign up, before any of that.
top_gap.business-running: Get main green again: add a migration granting the seven Guided Planet tables to the right roles, apply it before Supabase's 30 October change, and fix the failing Vercel builds on main's head.

runs.one_thing: Send the 30 warm ring messages and get five real families signed up and running one week, because nothing else we built this month is proven until someone uses it.
runs.roundup:
A huge week for building and a quiet one for families. 142 pull requests merged, only one is open and it is a day old, and main is green again after a red patch on 9 November. Almost every task the board set on 13 October was built within three days, but the board never ran again to tick them off, so for a month the list said 23 things were late when 21 were done. The Friday board routine fired every week and wrote nothing, and the Wednesday walkthrough has never saved a report. Fixing that comes first.

What is stuck is the bit that matters. Most of the week went into schools, French, Etsy and ads. We had 4 stage checks in 30 days, nobody has signed up since 28 September, no family has finished a day since then, and revenue is £0. The 30 warm messages from the first 20 sign ups plan were drafted in Gmail on 6 November and, as far as the repo knows, never sent.

The one thing: five real families signed up and running one week.

What I need from you. Send the 30 warm ring messages this week. Tell me whether the founder checkout went through with a real card. Pay the ICO fee or tell me it is paid, it has been snoozed for four weeks. Pick the real Vercel project. And say whether new school and Etsy builds can pause until those five families are in.

headlines.value-above-ai: The four things a chatbot cannot do are now named in a parent's words on the home page, the choose screen and the upgrade page, and each one has a proof path in code. What is still missing is proof that a real family feels three of them in week one.
headlines.solves-problem: The gap from last time is closed: phones, seen something and controller fights now all hand the parent the right words tonight, but there is no proof yet that any real family has seen a worry get smaller.
headlines.right-audience: The customer is right, named and now holds at the young edge with an honest 'come back at 4', but the home page still describes itself in our words and nothing yet proves this parent can be reached.
headlines.will-pay: The ask is now honest, safe and says what a free chatbot cannot do, but nobody real has paid and checkout is not proven end to end by a real family.
headlines.simplicity-flow: The journey page now has one name in the menu and its heading, but the home screen keeps stacking cards beside the lead and the route still carries the old word.
headlines.keeps-coming-back: The pull is now well built for parent and child, and the evening nudge stops when a parent goes quiet, but no family has finished a day since 28 September, so none of it is proven to hold anyone.
headlines.marketing: The funnel, the guard and the per channel number are all built, but nothing shows the number is being read, and many pieces in the walkthrough campaign and the 9 November week do not end at the stage check.
headlines.ux-expert: The tap target and focus ring gap from October is closed and guarded, so the system now meets the 7 row, but about 1,400 raw hex colours remain and I could not walk the screens in a browser to judge empty, loading and error states.
headlines.competitor-watch: A quiet fortnight: nobody has shipped our core loop, Kairoo is still only a waitlist, and last time's wrong Jigsaw price is now fixed.
headlines.ai-tools-watch: The model ladder is now current and caching and batching are in use, but a new Fable is reported out and DiGi still defaults to 5.1, and the weekly board routine does nothing.
headlines.business-running: Claude's work moves fast and clean, but the board went silent for a month, the walkthrough never saves, two of Justin's tasks have been snoozed for four weeks, and almost none of the week pointed at getting a real family to the stage check.

top_gap.value-above-ai: Make three of the four things visible in the first 48 hours without the parent hunting for them. After the first worry check in, show 'Day 1 is your starting point, we will show you where it moves' on Home. After the first DiGi answer, show 'last time you told me X' as a quoted line. Send a child app first-open nudge that names the child. Then count 'first week, three felt' in the product pulse.
top_gap.solves-problem: Make the first week payoff real. When a worry has only one or two ratings, What is working and the weekly review email should say plainly 'here is where you started, here is the next look', and show the start point against the first words you tried. Then check it with one seeded family on a fortnight of check ins, so that a parent sees the line move.
top_gap.right-audience: Rewrite the home page title, description and Open Graph text, and the FaqAccordion 'what do I get' answer, in the parent's words (the nightly fight, the phone coming, what to say tonight) instead of 'evidence informed', 'Digital Passport', 'wellbeing tracker' and a 15 item feature list. Also add the plain child age beside the stage names Shaper and Independent in the stage cards.
top_gap.will-pay: Get one real paying family, or write down the named reason there is none yet. Today there are no day to day users, the last completed day was 28 September, and the only payer is Justin. The first 20 signups plan is the route.
top_gap.simplicity-flow: Cap the parent home at the lead plus one slot: fold the sticker news, catch up, DiGi word, DiGi question, phone bridge, school ahead, term preview and school window cards into one rotating slot chosen through lib/home/next-up.ts, and keep the rest in the More menu.
top_gap.keeps-coming-back: Show the lifetime days shown up beside the flame, and put one warm line on the dashboard after a restart, so a missed day never reads as zero. This respects the decision of no grace day. Today streak.total is read in only one place.
top_gap.marketing: Make the stage check the last line of every parent facing piece in the walkthrough campaign and the 9 November week (the Robux DiGi piece, and playlists 03, 08 and 13), add a guard like check-live-domain that fails if a parent facing file in content/ lacks a starter-pack link or the hook line, and mark the school pieces (02, 06, 11, 15) as a different audience in schedule.md.
top_gap.ux-expert: Move raw hex values in components and pages onto tokens, starting with the most repeated colours, and add a guard that fails on new hex outside shared/tokens.css, with a baseline file like larger-text-baseline.json.
top_gap.competitor-watch: Add a new sightings entry for TAP: Tech Activity Pact (iPhone and iPad app, agreements teens propose and parents sign, daily check ins, family streak, renegotiation, from $9.99 a month, ages 9 to 17). It is a second Kairoo style agreement app already live in the App Store, so the sightings log's 'Kairoo is the only one' framing needs updating. Nothing to borrow beyond the renegotiate a rule idea, which fits the existing protected time ask in lib/quests/time-tiers.ts.
top_gap.ai-tools-watch: Fix the weekly board routine so it saves a run file and scorecard (it last 'succeeded' in 71 seconds on 6 November having written nothing), and make the Wednesday UX walkthrough save its report to plans/review-board/walkthroughs/. Both are routines that run and leave no result.
top_gap.business-running: Make the Friday board routine save its run every week: give it an instructions file in plans/review-board/routines/ read from origin/main, have it find what it needs with git rather than listing pull requests (the cause of the 09:17 radar run doing nothing on 11 November), and commit runs/<date>.md or print the report and say it could not save.
